paragraphs.text: Gastal is an apocalyptic wasteland plane of gas, dragonic warlords, road warriors, and colossal dry lightning storms. It the home of the Endriders and the ferocious scorpion dragon Akul .

Gastal is a dying world, crossed by mounted scavengers and nomads who roar across its permanently sunset-washed landscapes seeking rare oases to settle or raid. Water, food, and peace are in short supply, but gas and oil always were plentiful. With nothing left but the open road and a bottomless tank of fuel, the plane's population has taken to their roaring machines to chase glory ahead and leave the dead behind. With scarce resources, the plane's population frequently engages in "water wars" to control the plane's few remaining supplies. It is currently unknown when the apocalypse that defines Gastal as it is now occurred. This event may predate Urza's time, as the plane was considered an "abandoned world" in the novel Planeswalker , where it was depicted as a "barren, twilight plain".

At some point in Gastal's past, the plane "died" in an apocalyptic event. While the details are unknown, the event left behind a decimated population in a hostile world where resources such as food or water were scarce. In this post-apocalyptic environment, multiple conflicts were fought over Gastal's dwindling resources, and raiding gangs of scavengers would raid the remaining remnants of civilization for food and water. Maximum Overdrive refers to The Fuel Wars, although it is unknown if this was a shorter series of conflicts or a larger period of Gastal's history.

Some time between c. 880 and 1500 AR , Gastal was chosen as the location for a meeting of planeswalkers . Urza attended the meeting with Xantcha in hopes of being led to the plane from which the Phyrexians originated. The meeting was interrupted by an attack from an unseen force, and the planeswalker Manatarqua was killed. Urza was forced to abandon his plans on the plane and continue his quest for Phyrexia elsewhere.

Once the plane became connected to the rest of the Multiverse via the opening of the Omenpaths in 4562 AR , the inhabitants were no longer bound to the plane. Endrider gangs and other inhabitants fled the plane looking for planes for food, water, and easier raiding.
The scorpion dragon Akul to traveled to Thunder Junction and formed The Hellspurs .

Many Endrider gangs found plentiful food and water in the greater multiverse, but gasoline was scarce or unheard of outside of Gastal. The gangs used to running their vehicles at full power quickly burned through their fuel. This left such gangs stranded and in need of alternative ways to fuel their vehicles.
One gang, led by Far Fortune , ended up stranded on Avishkar. Far Fortune and her crew found their way to the Ghirapur Grand Prix and formed the Endriders racing team.
